OUR PLANNED COMMITMENT50%

of Plato-Ride’s profits
for a greener city.

We plan to fund planting, irrigation, and ongoing tree care in Pune. The commitment applies to profits after business expenses, not to every fare.

Plato-Ride is in development. No profit allocations, trees planted, or emissions savings have been verified.

From promise to proof

  • Plant with purposeWork with local partners to identify suitable sites and species.
  • Keep caringInclude irrigation, maintenance, and survival monitoring.
  • Make progress visiblePlan reports backed by allocation records and partner evidence.

This website uses browser storage for sample bookings and offered rides. Booking data is not sent to a booking service or synced to the mobile app. Google Maps is an external service; map requests and selected route links are handled by Google.

Before a real-world launch

Secure identity checks, driver onboarding, live routing, location permissions, payments, emergency assistance, and operational support must be connected and tested. Native Android and iPhone source code is included with this project; public app-store releases are not available yet.
